core_obligations: Choose a presentation of the given module over the polynomial algebra on the fibre product (proof lines 1111-1130).
Split the presentation matrix into the blocks corresponding to the two factors and obtain the two base changed modules (proof lines 1130-1145).
Verify that these two modules together with their identification determine the original module, which is the assertion (proof lines 1145-1156).

difficulty_reason: The lemma describes a finitely presented module over a fibre product of rings as a pair of modules over the two factors together with an identification after base change, and the proof is a 46-line construction. It chooses a presentation of the module over the polynomial algebra on the fibre product, writes the presentation matrix in the two blocks corresponding to the two factors, and verifies that the data obtained after base change along each factor determines the module back. The construction of the two modules and the verification that they glue are both displayed.
